scenario: LGRA.10.1.3 with LGRA.10.1.4: an action of the outer RHS after the one containing a nested `withdraw t` may still read `t`, because the body runs later. The `log` after the `call` reads `{t.v}`. Compiles. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s outer walk, where a nested `withdraw` counts as a reference and never starts the outer count (`withdrawn_step` inserts only a top-level one). Refusing this program is the break. Twin: LGRA.10.1.3_nested_body_reads_after_its_withdraw.
rules_ds:
schema NotifySendReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    status: Int

service notify.send:
    kwarg n: Int
    response NotifySendReply

schema Trig scope explicit:
    v: Int

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call notify.send n: 1 cooldown: 30_s
        on response.status == 200:
            withdraw t
    log info "still here {t.v}"
